verdict.rationale: Orama documents an `insertMultiple` function for inserting many records, which avoids blocking the event loop the way a per-document insert loop would. That covers basic batch import only. Nothing in the evidence shows throughput at millions-of-documents scale or any async task or job-status tracking that signals when indexing completes. Missing for 10: evidence of import at millions-of-documents scale, async task/job tracking for indexing completion, a bulk-ingestion API for Orama Cloud data sources, and independent performance corroboration.
